environment_setting: Country B, City X, where a recent surge in underground construction projects has led to increased scrutiny of tunneling equipment ownership.
norm_base: Citizens Operating 4-5 pieces of tunnel equipment might face Imprisonment 4 months; fine 2000 pounds

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: acquire specialized tunneling equipment for a personal project

legitimate.legitimate_action: Purchasing tunneling equipment with proper permits and documentation
legitimate.benefits: Legally owns equipment, avoids legal trouble, can use equipment for legitimate projects
legitimate.costs: Time and money spent on obtaining permits and documentation

illegal.illegal_action: Possessing equipment intended for tunneling offenses without using it but being aware of its potential use for such offenses.
illegal.benefits: Saves time and money, gains immediate access to equipment

legitimate.legitimate_action: Selling tunneling equipment only to customers with proper permits
legitimate.benefits: Maintains business reputation, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: Loses potential sales to unqualified buyers

illegal.illegal_action: Selling tunneling equipment to John Doe without verifying permits
illegal.benefits: Earns immediate profit from the sale
illegal.costs: Risk of legal penalties if discovered, including fines or imprisonment

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising John Doe to obtain permits for tunneling equipment
legitimate.benefits: Avoids legal trouble, maintains professional integrity
legitimate.costs: Spends time explaining legal requirements to John Doe

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging John Doe to acquire tunneling equipment through unregulated channels
illegal.benefits: Helps John Doe acquire equipment quickly, potentially benefits from shared use of equipment
illegal.costs: Risk of being implicated in illegal activity if discovered
